title: UPLC-CAPE Metadata Schema
description: Schema for benchmark submission metadata in the UPLC-CAPE framework

name.description: Name of the compiler or toolchain

commit_hash.description: Full Git commit hash (40 characters) of the compiler version

min_protocol_version.description: Cardano protocol version this artifact requires to be accepted on-chain. Set it whenever the program uses a feature gated behind a hard fork: builtin casing and the batch-6 builtins (dropList, expModInteger, BLS12-381 multi-scalar multiplication, arrays, multi-asset values) require protocol version 11 (van Rossem). This is a property of the artifact and does not change when CAPE's evaluator moves. Omit for artifacts that use no gated feature. CAPE does not enforce it during measurement: the evaluator runs with testing machine parameters that enable every builtin regardless of protocol version, so a submission above the current mainnet protocol version still measures successfully. Use min_plutus_version to route such a submission to the preview evaluator.

min_plutus_version.description: Evaluator-routing knob, not a statement about on-chain requirements (use min_protocol_version for that). Set it only when the production evaluator cannot run the artifact at all, e.g. because its CEK machine predates a language construct the program uses. Compared against CAPE_CURRENT_PLUTUS_VERSION in scripts/lib/cape_versions.sh: a submission above that threshold is measured with the preview evaluator instead of the production one, and is skipped by 'cape submission verify --all'. Omit for submissions the production evaluator can execute, which is the normal case. Which track a submission is rendered in is decided separately, by its directory-name variant suffix.

contributors.description: Information about the contributors (all fields optional for privacy)

name.description: Name or handle of the contributor

date.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the submission was created

source_available.description: Whether source code is publicly available

source_repository.description: URL to source code repository (if source_available is true)

source_commit_hash.description: Full Git commit hash (40 characters) of the source code used for this submission

implementation_notes.description: Notes about the implementation approach, algorithms, or design decisions
